messages:
maria: Heads-up: after last night's KMS rewrap + RBAC role rename some customers are seeing SSO failures and SCIM deprovision flapping. Need triage now.

sanjay: Error samples? IdPs?

maria: Azure AD + Okta. authproxy shows: 
```
2026-03-23T01:55:03Z authproxy ERROR saml: decryptAssertion: KMSDecryptFailed: InvalidCiphertextException user=acct-xyz extid=U:abcd1234
```

jen: InvalidCiphertext -> encryption context mismatch or different key version. Ops did a rolling rewrap at ~01:40?

maria: Yes. Also applied RBAC rename org:admin -> org:admin_v2 in same window. ops-bot confirms deploy.

ops-bot: deploy/redwood-identity-2026-03-23 completed by @ops at 01:42 UTC :white_check_mark:

dmitri: Two changes together likely caused missing audit correlation. If assertion fails to decrypt, deprov worker may mark stale without emitting audit events (we've seen that bug).

maria: Confirmed: missing deprov audit entries; auditstore has gaps for extids affected.

sanjay: Immediate plan: pause SCIM deprov queue, halt further rewraps, attempt remap to previous KMS version, and run dry-run replays to regenerate audit events.

sec-oncall: Oncall actioning: pausing queue and opening incident. Also check for permissive fallback in code paths in case parse failed.

ops-bot: Queue/scim-deprov paused by @ops at 02:03 UTC

maria: KMS metadata: LastRewrap: 2026-03-23T01:41:12Z, EncryptionContext: {"env":"prod","service":"authproxy","wrap_id":"wrap-20260323-01"}. Old context used wrap-20260322-99.

dmitri: That explains InvalidCiphertextException. Can we remap alias to old key version?

maria: Old version v23 is still present and not scheduled for deletion. I can remap alias back for rollback if approved.

sanjay: Approve temporary remap. Also implement compatibility shim to accept old RBAC name for 24h to avoid 403s due to cached sessions.

jen: For compliance: collect list of deprovs from 01:40-02:10, backfill audits after rollback, and notify customers. Also fix the deprov worker bug so parse failures emit explicit AuditEvent (deprov_failed/decrypt_error).

sec-oncall: SEV-2 INC-2026-0423 opened. Owners: ops=rollback, eng-identity=shim + test, security=audit/backfill + vuln triage.

maria: Alias remapped to v23 at 02:22 UTC; sample assertion now decrypts. Dry-run showed 18 missing deprov events that we can backfill. Pausing before mutating state.

dmitri: Add integration test matrix: KMS rewrap scenarios + SDK versions + RBAC rename cache behavior. Prevent regressions.

jen: Patch note: on assertion parse failure -> emit AuditEvent{type:deprov_failed, reason:decrypt_error, assertion_id:unknown, extid:provided}. Add unit + e2e.

maria: I'll run backfill and draft customer timeline/RCA. Will update when backfill validated. :phone: 

ops-bot: incident/INC-2026-0423 created and paging for oncall escalation.
